env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.note: Used only with Gemini provider selection enabled in settings JSON.

note: Requires Gemini provider selection in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json as well as environment settings. GEMINI_API_KEY alone has no effect and .env is not loaded. Only Gemini-compatible endpoints are documented. The antigravity launcher alias and CLI v1.5.8 release date remain unverified.
